read.thesis: Q2 sales +7.5% with PSG same-store +4.2%, but price-led growth and a moderate raw-material squeeze; management flags second-half demand softness and an 8% PSG price increase effective September 1.

triggers.label: PSG 8% price increase effective Sept 1
triggers.quote: including an announced 8% price increase in Paint Stores Group effective September 1.

triggers.label: Demand softness flagged for 2H
triggers.quote: customer sentiment and the leading indicators we track point to continued demand softness in the second half

guidance.quote: Increasing full year 2026 adjusted diluted net income per share guidance in the range of $11.80 to $12.20 per share
consolidated Net sales expected to be up a mid to high-single digit percentage compared to full year 2025
we expect third quarter 2026 consolidated Net sales to be up a mid to high-single digit percentage

red_flags.label: Price-led growth amid demand softness
red_flags.quote: Net sales increased in all professional customer end markets

red_flags.label: Interest expense up 21%
red_flags.quote: additional interest expense attributable to an increase in short-term borrowings and long-term debt
